approval_text: I approve D-PG-6 pre-analysis numerical conventions exactly as follows: deterministic item-cluster percentile bootstrap, B = 10,000 replicates, seed 0; paired arms computed within the same replicate on the same resampled item set; trace-level proportions with the source item as resampling unit and no item-majority aggregation; and analysis code frozen by commit/hash after synthetic-only validation and before judge or human outputs are unsealed. Missing values and zero denominators follow the existing contract: report full missingness, leave undefined quantities undefined, and do not impute them.
